svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 50 x 147.5 mm blanks of 4 mm plate; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure down from the top edge and sideways from the centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail bolts 6.5 mm at 12.5 down, 15 each side of centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: press axle hole 16.5 mm at 127.5 down, centred;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: handle bolts 8.5 mm at 32.4 down, 13.3 to the rear of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and at 50.8 down, 2.1 forward of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the outside face of each rail, top edge flush with the rail top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 660 mm behind the rail front. The flattened lower end of a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: handle tube bolts flat to its outside face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the axle hole lines up across both plates.
